Overview

\n\n

The eUI\n Platform (eUI) is meant to ease development of Single Web Page\n Applications (SPAs) providing rich User Experience (UX) starting point\n to directly quick-start applications development.

\n\n

It's also focusing on rationalisation and implementation of European Commission's User Experience (UX@EC) and the adoption\n of a common look and feel for your web applications.

\n\n

Thereby, the eUI framework provides guidelines and recommendations on\n collaborative and reusable web components in order to help\n to build common and homogeneous graphical web interfaces that reflects the European\n Commission Style Guides towards a corporate look and feel.\n It also offers consistency from User Experience point of view through various participant projects\n such as Opsys, MyWorkplace, Compass Corporate, Assmal, eProcurement, Sygma, Sedia, etc.

\n\n

The target audience goes from Developers who will find a lot of usefull technical information, but\n also Designers who want to reuse such materials to illustrate their work as well as Analysts and\n Managers to help them during conceptual phases.

\n\n

Feel free to participate and help to improve the eUI platform.

\n
